name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: We should assign a dedicated blocker facilitator from within each team to oversee and resolve link coverage issues. This decision allows for faster resolution of blockers and increased accountability, which is crucial for achieving the goal of pushing link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day. By doing so, we accept the trade-off of increased personnel workload, as these facilitators will need to dedicate time to resolving blockers. This trade-off is worth it, as it enables us to make consistent progress toward our goal without getting bogged down by unresolved issues.

name: Scriv
text: Rotating ownership of blockers won’t solve the core problem—it just spreads the pain. The real risk is that teams will deprioritize link coverage when it’s not *their* blocker today, creating a feast-or-famine cycle that misses the +5%/day target. Instead, enforce a single accountable owner for the entire link coverage initiative, with clear escalation paths when progress stalls. That settles the argument: measure daily deltas, not heroics.
